title: Anthropic secures $1.8bn cloud deal with Akamai for AI expansion
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Akamai 达成 18 亿美元的云协议以拓展 AI
summary: Akamai lands its biggest-ever cloud contract, marking a major push beyond content delivery into AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: Akamai 获得了有史以来最大的云合同，标志着从内容交付到人工智能基础设施的重大推动。

title: VNQI Offers Broad International Real Estate at Low Cost. RWX Takes a Narrower, Pricier Path.
title_zh: VNQI 以低成本提供广泛的国际房地产。 RWX 走的是一条更窄、更昂贵的道路。
summary: With over five times the holdings and a broader international reach, VNQI takes a different approach to global real estate exposure.
summary_zh: VNQI 拥有超过五倍的持股量和更广泛的国际影响力，对全球房地产投资采取了不同的方法。

title: Apollo Strikes Deals for Two Live-Events Businesses
title_zh: 阿波罗为两家现场活动业务达成交易
summary: Apollo Global Management  struck deals for two different live-events businesses as part of a plan to create a platform for in-person gatherings.
summary_zh: 作为创建面对面聚会平台计划的一部分，阿波罗全球管理公司为两家不同的现场活动业务达成了交易。

title: Oil Climbs as Hormuz Stays Shut After Trump Rebuffs Iran’s Offer

title: US, Iran Wrangle Over Terms of Deal to End War and Reopen Hormuz
title_zh: 美国和伊朗就结束战争和重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议条款争论不休
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The US and Iran remain far apart on a framework to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with President Donald Trump calling the Islamic Republic’s reply to his proposed peace plan unworkable.Most Read from BloombergIran Makes New Offer on Uranium in Re...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国和伊朗在结束战争和重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的框架上仍存在很大分歧，唐纳德·特朗普总统称伊朗伊斯兰共和国对其拟议和平计划的答复不可行。
